intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.content: DIY Kiosk ("we", "our", "the app") is committed to protecting user privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when using the DIY Kiosk app on Android and the website diy-kiosk.store.

dataCollection.title: 2. Data We Collect
dataCollection.deviceDataIntro: DIY Kiosk operates on an offline-first model, meaning most data is stored locally on your device:
deviceDataList: Payment configuration (payOS API keys if configured)
dataCollection.deviceDataNote: This data is not sent to our servers. The data remains entirely on your device and you have full control over it.
dataCollection.websiteDataIntro: When you subscribe for updates on diy-kiosk.store, we collect:

dataUsage.title: 3. How We Use Your Data
list: Device data: Only used for app functionality (sales management, invoice printing)
Email: To send notifications about app updates and new features (no spam, not shared with third parties)

thirdParty.title: 4. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.googlePlayContent: The app is distributed via Google Play Store. Google may collect data according to their policies. Please see

storage.title: 5. Data Storage and Security
list: App data is stored in local storage (IndexedDB) and device secure storage
API keys are stored securely using Android's Secure Storage
Email data is stored on encrypted secure servers

rights.title: 6. Your Rights
list: Delete app data: Uninstall the app or clear data in Android Settings
Unsubscribe from emails: Click the "Unsubscribe" link in emails or contact us
Export your data: Use the backup feature in the app

children.title: 7. Children's Privacy
children.content: DIY Kiosk is designed for business users and is not directed at children under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

changes.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with a new update date.

contact.title: 9. Contact Us
contact.intro: If you have questions about this privacy policy, please contact us:
